items.title: Papa León XIV cancela todos los actos hasta el 20 de octubre debido a operación de pulmón programada
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El papa León XIV ha cancelado todos los actos públicos que tenía programados hasta el 20 de octubre, informó el lunes el Vaticano, antes de su ingreso en el hospital para extirpar un pequeño nódulo detectado en uno de sus pulmones.
items.body:
El papa León XIV ha cancelado todos los actos públicos que tenía programados hasta el 20 de octubre, informó el lunes el Vaticano, antes de su ingreso en el hospital para extirpar un pequeño nódulo detectado en uno de sus pulmones.
León XIV, de 71 años, dijo el que "recientemente, durante una revisión, los médicos me han detectado un nódulo localizado en el pulmón. Se ha detectado todavía en una fase muy temprana y está bien localizado".
Se espera que el papa ingrese en el hospital Gemelli de Roma a el martes, informó la oficina de prensa del Vaticano a primera hora del lunes. No se especificó cuándo tendría lugar la operación propiamente dicha.

items.title: Michael Jordan’s Game 2 ‘98 Finals jersey sells for record $14 million
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The jersey Michael Jordan wore during Game 2 of the "Last Dance" 1998 NBA Finals has sold for a record $14 million.
items.body:
The jersey Michael Jordan wore during Game 2 of the "Last Dance" 1998 NBA Finals has sold for a record $14 million.
Hunt Auctions announced on Monday that the game-worn, autographed Chicago Bulls jersey was purchased by Miami real estate investor Ron Firman in a private sale.
It's the highest price ever paid for a piece of basketball memorabilia, and according to the auction house, the newly sold Jordan jersey ranks as the second-largest sale in history among game-worn sports jerseys. The New York Yankees jersey worn by Babe Ruth in Game 3 of the 1932 World Series -- during which Ruth called his shot ahead of a home run -- went for $24.12 million in 2024.
Jordan and the Bulls defeated the Utah Jazz in six games to win the 1998 championship, the sixth and final title of his career in Chicago. Game 2, played on June 5, 1998, in Salt Lake City, saw Chicago even the series 1-1 in large part due to a dominant performance from its superstar guard. Jordan put up 37 points, five rebounds, and three assists in a 93-88 victory. He would go on to collect his sixth and final Finals MVP award, two more than anyone else in NBA history, nine days later.
The wildly popular "Last Dance" documentary, released in 2020, was centered around that 1997-98 Bulls season.
"The record-setting price achieved for the related Michael Jordan jersey is yet another corroborative result as to the significance of Jordan within the industry and popular culture. This remarkable garment bore witness to one of Jordan's most hallowed NBA Finals appearances as part of his 'Last Dance' season to complete his illustrious career," David Hunt, president of Hunt Auctions, said in a statement.
"While Michael Jordan's importance within the sports memorabilia marketplace has long been established, it has now escalated to an elite asset class more typically reserved for iconic works of art. We are very pleased to have been able to facilitate this historic sale which serves as another benchmark for our industry."
The previous record for a basketball memorabilia item was $12.26 million for the home jersey worn by Jordan in Game 3 of the 1998 Finals, which was sold via auction in September.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Xpeng executive says EV maker will expand European production ahead of local content rules
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Chinese EV maker Xpeng plans to expand its European production in order to comply with new European Union rules mandating minimum local content in electric cars, company vice president Yeqing Zheng told Reuters at the Paris car show.
items.body:
Chinese EV maker Xpeng (9868.HK) plans to expand its European production in order to comply with new European Union rules mandating minimum local content in electric cars, company vice president Yeqing Zheng told Reuters at the Paris car show.
Magna currently produces EVs under contract for Xpeng at a factory in Austria.
Zheng said the volume at that factory "is not even sufficient" for Xpeng's needs as the company expects to continue growing by "high double digits" in Europe.
The executive told Reuters that the additional production would be in partnership with a local manufacturer either to build a new plant or operate an existing one.
The new production line would focus on building “mid-level” vehicles and would need to have a lower cost base than the factory in Austria.
Zheng said the new assembly line should start production by the time the European Union’s ‘made in Europe’ rules take effect.
The Xpeng executive told Reuters that a decision on a new production line will be made within months.
The Chinese EV maker is currently working on building out a local supply chain to support more production and it will be "challenging" to find a battery supplier that can meet Xpeng's charging needs and produce cells with the right energy density.

items.title: BTG Pactual obtiene licencia para operar como banco en Perú con capital inicial de US$100 millones
items.author: Sérgio Ripardo (ES)
items.summary: La operación en Perú representa la expansión del banco en América Latina; se enfocará en clientes corporativos, grandes empresas e inversionistas institucionales, y complementará los servicios que ya ...
items.body: Bloomberg Línea — BTG Pactual recibió la licencia de funcionamiento para operar como institución bancaria en Perú, otorgada por la SBS (Superintendencia de Banca, Seguros y AFP). La autorización marca la conclusión del proceso regulatorio iniciado en julio de 2025 y consolida la trayectoria de expansión internacional del mayor banco de inversiones de América Latina en los mercados de la región, según un comunicado difundido por BTG Pactual. Ver más : Acción de Nu rebota tras su mayor caída desde 2025: 5 claves de la posible compra de Monzo El nuevo banco operará bajo el nombre de Banco BTG Pactual Perú S.A., con un capital inicial de US$100 millones. La operación está dirigida a clientes corporativos, grandes empresas e inversionistas institucionales, complementando los servicios que BTG Pactual ya ofrece en el país andino. “Estamos profundizando nuestra presencia en América Latina, y la licencia para operar un banco en Perú representa un paso más en esta estrategia”, afirma Roberto Sallouti, CEO de BTG Pactual, en un comunicado enviado a la prensa. En opinión del directivo, esta iniciativa refuerza el compromiso a largo plazo del banco con el país andino y forma parte de una “trayectoria que se ha ido construyendo desde hace años, con avances en tecnología, nuevos productos y servicios, y la expansión a nuevas regiones”. Sallouti agregó que esta evolución le permite al banco “ofrecer una plataforma cada vez más completa a los clientes, combinando la experiencia local, la tecnología y la escala de BTG Pactual en la región”. BTG Pactual lleva más de 14 años presente en el mercado peruano. Hasta ahora, operaba como banco de inversión, correduría y gestora de activos. La nueva licencia amplía significativamente su ámbito de actuación, permitiendo operaciones de banca corporativa, tesorería y banca de inversión integradas bajo una única institución regulada. Esta estructura consolidada fortalece la capacidad del grupo para ofrecer soluciones más integrales a los clientes peruanos, según el comunicado. El banco podrá ahora estructurar financiamiento corporativo, gestionar flujos de efectivo en monedas extranjeras y coordinar operaciones de fusiones y adquisiciones con mayor eficiencia regulatoria. Ver más : Más de 110 proyectos buscan capital en América Latina: el BID apunta a destrabar la inversión La entrada al mercado bancario peruano forma parte de la estrategia de consolidación internacional de BTG Pactual, que cuenta con más de cuatro décadas de operación y presencia en los principales centros financieros de las Américas, Europa y Asia. En los últimos años, el grupo ha intensificado sus movimientos de expansión, particularmente en la región latinoamericana. Además de sus operaciones en Perú, BTG Pactual ha fortalecido su presencia en Uruguay y ha ampliado significativamente sus operaciones en EE.UU., un mercado estratégico para la captación de capital y la estructuración de operaciones transfronterizas. La decisión de la SBS se produce en un momento de relativa estabilidad del sistema financiero peruano, que experimenta una recuperación gradual tras ciclos de incertidumbre política. Según BTG, la autorización refleja la confianza regulatoria en el grupo, que ya demuestra solidez patrimonial y experiencia comprobada en el país. Con la licencia aprobada, BTG Pactual entra en la etapa final de preparación operativa para iniciar sus actividades. El banco deberá ajustar su infraestructura tecnológica, finalizar las contrataciones y adaptar sus sistemas a los requisitos específicos del regulador peruano antes del inicio efectivo de las operaciones, según el comunicado. La estructura peruana le permite a BTG Pactual aprovechar la creciente demanda de servicios financieros sofisticados entre las empresas medianas y grandes del país, además de ofrecer acceso directo a inversionistas institucionales peruanos y regionales para sus productos de gestión de recursos, agregó el banco. items.title: Hackers aquecem geladeiras de supermercado na França, provocando incêndios e perdas de alimentos
items.author: Leo Marchandon, Gabriel Stargardter
items.creator: Leo Marchandon, Gabriel Stargardter
items.summary: Hackers elevaram a temperatura de muitos refrigeradores de supermercados franceses para 50 graus Celsius durante a noite, causando incêndios e perdas de alimentos em centenas de lojas em todo o país, em um grande ataque cibernético.
items.body:
Hackers elevaram a temperatura de muitos refrigeradores de supermercados franceses para 50 graus Celsius durante a noite, causando incêndios e perdas de alimentos em centenas de lojas em todo o país, em um grande ataque cibernético.
A Procuradoria de Paris afirmou que um ataque de "grande escala" estava "afetando refrigeradores conectados em diversas grandes redes de supermercados na França" e relatou danos como "perda de alimentos e incêndios".
Entretanto, o primeiro-ministro Sébastien Lecornu instruiu a Agência Nacional de Segurança Cibernética da França (ANSSI) a investigar o caso, segundo uma fonte de seu gabinete.
Eles disseram que a França "estava coordenando ações com seus homólogos europeus, já que outros países também podem ser afetados", enquanto investigava se outras empresas francesas corriam risco.
O Carrefour (CARR.PA) afirmou que 80 de seus supermercados foram afetados, enquanto a Monoprix disse que 5% de suas lojas sofreram impactos.
A Les Mousquetaires, proprietária da rede varejista Intermarché, informou que os refrigeradores de cerca de 150 de suas lojas foram aquecidos a 50 graus Celsius durante seis horas na noite anterior. Todos os alimentos foram descartados para evitar riscos sanitários, afirmou um porta-voz.
O presidente-executivo da Cooperativa U, Dominique Schelcher, disse que seu supermercado também foi vítima.
"Atacar equipamentos essenciais para a conservação de produtos frescos e para o abastecimento alimentar do povo francês é de extrema gravidade e não tem precedentes", escreveu ele no X.
E. Leclerc e Auchan não responderam aos pedidos de comentários.
Não havia uma estimativa imediata da dimensão das perdas do setor.
"O comércio de varejo e atacado desempenha um papel essencial no abastecimento da Europa com os bens de que as pessoas dependem diariamente", afirmou Christel Delberghe, diretora-geral da Eurocommerce, associação europeia do varejo. " Este incidente destaca a importância da resiliência em toda a cadeia de abastecimento."
QUESTÃO DE SEGURANÇA HOLANDESA A operadora holandesa de supermercados Ahold Delhaize, que administra a maior rede de supermercados da Holanda, a Albert Heijn, e tem operações significativas nos Estados Unidos, afirmou que também estava lidando com um "problema de segurança" em sua rede e que havia desativado vários sistemas para protegê-los.
Um aplicativo para smartphones da varejista informou aos clientes que, devido a um "incidente de segurança cibernética", não era possível entregar as compras.
Os pedidos online representam cerca de 10% das vendas da Albert Heijn. As lojas físicas permaneceram abertas e a agência de notícias holandesa ANP informou que os concorrentes registraram um aumento nos pedidos de entrega.
Não ficou claro se havia alguma ligação entre o ataque ao supermercado francês e os problemas apontados pela Ahold Delhaize.
A Ahold é a quarta maior varejista de supermercados dos EUA, e os sites de suas lojas Stop & Shop, Giant, Hannaford e Food Lion exibiam avisos informando que o site estava temporariamente fora do ar.
Não ficou claro se outras operações foram afetadas.
A fonte próxima a Lecornu afirmou que a ANSSI identificou uma vulnerabilidade em um software fornecido pela empresa dinamarquesa Danfoss.
A Danfoss afirmou estar "ciente de incidentes na França que afetaram um número limitado de sistemas de gerenciamento de refrigeração".
As unidades afetadas "estavam executando firmware desatualizado", disse a Danfoss, acrescentando que "há muito tempo aconselha os clientes a manterem os sistemas suportados atualizados com o firmware mais recente e a migrarem os sistemas legados para soluções de geração atual".
Em 9 de agosto, a Team82, empresa de cibersegurança da Claroty, publicou uma análise detalhando vulnerabilidades no controlador Danfoss AK-SM 800A. A Team82 informou que a Danfoss atualizou seu software para corrigir as vulnerabilidades, que poderiam ter permitido burlar os procedimentos normais de login e executar códigos maliciosos em dispositivos comprometidos.
Os ciberataques franceses apresentam semelhanças com as interrupções no fornecimento de refrigeração nos EUA no final de agosto, quando os refrigeradores dos refeitórios de cerca de uma dúzia de bases militares americanas foram afetados, resultando em perdas de alimentos.

items.title: Greenland lawmakers signal support for Trump security deal
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A majority of Greenlandic lawmakers signalled support for the Arctic island's recent security agreement with US President Donald Trump in a debate on Monday, although some opposition party members questioned the deal's economic value.
items.body:
A majority of Greenlandic lawmakers signalled support for the Arctic island's recent [USN:L6N45E07X TEXT:"security agreement"] with US President Donald Trump in a debate on Monday, although some opposition party members questioned the deal's economic value.
The United States, Denmark and Greenland last month [USN:L6N45E0KZ TEXT:"signed the agreement"], aimed at ending tensions after Trump's repeated threats to take control of the strategically located and mineral-rich island.
The agreement is subject to a second reading in parliament before being put to a vote, with lawmakers expected to pass the legislation.
The deal [USN:L1N45D0X6 TEXT:"expands the US military's role"] in Greenland, paving the way for two new military bases and Trump's "Golden Dome" [USN:L1N41P17X TEXT:"missile defence system"], while reaffirming Danish sovereignty and Greenlanders' right to self-determination.
The chair of opposition party Naleraq, Pele Broberg, said many details still remained unclear on how the agreement would work in practice.
"The US is granted extensive rights in our country. The people of Greenland are not guaranteed any fixed payment for those rights," Broberg said in the parliamentary debate in Greenland's capital Nuuk.
The government parties, which have a majority of seats, defended the deal.
Former Foreign Minister Vivian Motzfeldt of the governing coalition's Demokraatit said Greenland had secured "massive" protection without having to pay for it, while winning recognition as an autonomous nation.
Foreign Minister Mute Egede said the deal was "a huge step forward" that could not be measured in terms of money.
Erik Jensen, chair of the Siumut party, said his party backed the deal.
"For several years, Siumut has been campaigning to ensure that agreements concerning Greenland are no longer concluded without Greenlandic participation... That is why we are satisfied," Jensen said.

items.title: Qualifier Shi stuns Eala in Wuhan Open
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Qualifier Shi Han stunned Alexandra Eala, ranked 198 places above her, in a 4-6 6-3 6-3 win at the Wuhan Open's first round on Monday.
items.body:
Qualifier Shi Han stunned Alexandra Eala, ranked 198 places above her, in a 4-6 6-3 6-3 win at the Wuhan Open's first round on Monday.
China's Shi, ranked 217th in the world, stuck to her strategy of targeting the edges of the court despite a first-set loss to the 13th seed, and pushed Eala back with powerful serves as she stormed to victory, cheered on by the home crowd.
"I tried to push myself in the serve... tried my best to win," said the 21-year-old, who held her head in disbelief after her first win over a top-20 ranked opponent.
The Philippines' Eala, who has risen to prominence with seven wins over top-10 ranked opponents this year, has struggled with her form over the last month, having also lost to 180th-ranked Tatiana Prozorova at the Singapore Open last month.

items.title: Rivalidade entre Europa e China ganha destaque no Salão do Automóvel de Paris
items.author: Nick Carey, Giulio Piovaccari
items.creator: Nick Carey, Giulio Piovaccari
items.summary: A indústria automobilística europeia reagiu à crescente concorrência chinesa no Salão do Automóvel de Paris, nesta segunda-feira, com uma onda de lançamentos de novos modelos e apoio renovado de Bruxelas, mesmo com as montadoras chinesas expandindo sua atuação na região.
items.body:
A indústria automobilística europeia reagiu à crescente concorrência chinesa no Salão do Automóvel de Paris, nesta segunda-feira, com uma onda de lançamentos de novos modelos e apoio renovado de Bruxelas, mesmo com as montadoras chinesas expandindo sua atuação na região.
O salão foi inaugurado dias depois de a União Europeia anunciar um acordo com a China para limitar as importações de veículos híbridos chineses para o bloco, com um limite de 350 mil unidades por ano, segundo um funcionário da Comissão Europeia. Embora os detalhes do acordo ainda não tenham sido finalizados, ele foi amplamente bem recebido pelos fabricantes europeus, embora alguns tenham afirmado que seria necessário mais apoio.
O presidente da Stellantis (STLAM.MI) , Antonio Filosa, afirmou que o acordo foi um "bom marco", mas que a fabricante da Fiat também estava buscando ajuda do governo italiano para lidar com os altos custos de energia e queria que Bruxelas agisse mais rapidamente em relação às regras de emissões de carbono.
A entrada maciça de veículos híbridos chineses na UE "não é sustentável", afirmou o presidente-executivo da Renault (RENA.PA) , François Provost, descrevendo o acordo como "melhor do que uma guerra comercial".
Zhao Fei, presidente da montadora chinesa Changan (000625.SZ) , disse que "não estava muito preocupado" com o acordo, que considerava um precursor das regras de conteúdo local "Made in Europe", que poderiam ser resolvidas instalando a produção na região.
Cerca de 20 marcas chinesas, incluindo BYD (002594.SZ) e Chery (9973.HK) , estão participando do evento, dobrando sua presença em relação a 2024 e buscando crescimento no exterior em meio à intensa concorrência e à demanda mais fraca no mercado interno.
Nos últimos três anos, as marcas chinesas ganharam participação de mercado rapidamente na Europa, enquanto as exportações chinesas de veículos híbridos para os 27 estados-membros da UE triplicaram, atingindo US$7,5 bilhões no primeiro semestre deste ano, segundo dados da alfândega chinesa.
O acordo UE-China pode afetar mais duramente a BYD, a Chery e a marca MG da estatal SAIC (600104.SS) , já que, juntas, representaram 90% das vendas de híbridos de marcas chinesas na UE nos primeiros oito meses de 2026, disseram analistas da Jefferies no domingo.
A BYD afirmou que o acordo representou uma pressão de curto prazo, mas que continua comprometida com a Europa.
Destacando os desafios enfrentados pelos fabricantes europeus, a Volkswagen informou na segunda-feira que suas entregas caíram 14,3% no terceiro trimestre, a maior queda trimestral em quatro anos, devido a um novo declínio na demanda em seu principal mercado, a China. As entregas também caíram na América do Norte e na Europa Ocidental.
Como parte de seus esforços para recuperar participação no mercado europeu, a Stellantis está lançando seis novos modelos de suas marcas europeias no evento e apresentando nove carros-conceito.
Na noite de domingo, o presidente-executivo Filosa saudou "a reinvenção de um ícone europeu" ao apresentar uma versão elétrica retrô acessível do Citroën 2CV.
A empresa também está adotando ciclos de desenvolvimento mais rápidos, ao estilo chinês, afirmou o diretor de tecnologia, Ned Curic, ao detalhar os planos de construir pequenos veículos elétricos na Itália usando uma plataforma que está sendo desenvolvida em parceria com a chinesa Leapmotor.
O chefe de crescimento da Renault, Fabrice Cambolive, afirmou na segunda-feira que a montadora poderá aumentar a produção de veículos elétricos na França em pelo menos 50% nos próximos 12 meses.
'SE ELES PARAREM DE EXPORTAR... ELES MORREM' Assim como outros salões do automóvel ocidentais, o de Paris estava em declínio até que as montadoras chinesas começaram a aparecer em peso há quatro anos.
Além da BYD e da Chery, a edição deste ano do salão apresenta novas marcas chinesas, como a Aito, enquanto a estatal Changan lança suas marcas Nevo e Avatr na Europa.
As montadoras chinesas também aproveitaram o evento para delinear planos de expansão na Europa. Zhao, da Changan, afirmou que a empresa está em negociações com fabricantes para a produção de veículos na Europa e espera produzir seu primeiro carro fabricado no continente no início de 2027.
A BYD está estudando a possibilidade de construir uma fábrica na França, declarou a vice-presidente executiva Stella Li à emissora BFM TV.
Em outubro de 2024, a UE impôs tarifas sobre veículos totalmente elétricos fabricados na China. Bruxelas também está trabalhando em regras "Made in Europe" que exigem níveis mínimos de conteúdo local para que os veículos elétricos tenham acesso a grande parte do mercado do bloco.
O presidente francês, Emmanuel Macron, afirmou durante o evento que um acordo entre a França e a Alemanha sobre as disposições é "iminente".
As montadoras chinesas têm buscado bases de produção na Europa antes da entrada em vigor das regras propostas, frequentemente em parceria com fabricantes já estabelecidos.
Em julho, a Geely Auto <0175.HK>, da China, anunciou que produziria SUVs elétricos em uma fábrica da Ford Motor (F.N) na Espanha.
Em comunicado separado, a Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles, da Índia, e a Stellantis anunciaram na segunda-feira que expandiram sua parceria para incluir tecnologia e desenvolvimento de produtos, com planos de fabricar veículos na Índia para mais de 50 mercados globais.
As vendas de automóveis na China, o maior mercado automotivo do mundo, caíram 20% no primeiro semestre de 2026, aumentando a pressão sobre as montadoras para expandirem suas operações no exterior.
Como o mercado norte-americano está praticamente fechado para a indústria automobilística chinesa, a Europa se tornou sua principal prioridade de exportação.
"Se eles deixarem de exportar para a Europa, eles vão à falência porque não conseguem ganhar dinheiro em outros lugares", disse François Roudier, secretário-geral da Organização Internacional de Fabricantes de Veículos Automotores.

items.title: Microsoft planeja grande implantação de chips de IA próprios para reduzir custos
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A Microsoft anunciou nesta segunda-feira a próxima geração de seu chip de inteligência artificial personalizado e disse que planeja implantar potencialmente mais de um milhão deles no próximo ano para dar suporte aos seus serviços internos de IA.
items.body:
A Microsoft (MSFT.O) anunciou nesta segunda-feira a próxima geração de seu chip de inteligência artificial personalizado e disse que planeja implantar potencialmente mais de um milhão deles no próximo ano para dar suporte aos seus serviços internos de IA.
O Maia 300, como o chip é chamado, é a terceira geração de chips personalizados da empresa, projetados para lidar com processamento de dados de IA, como codificação e execução de tarefas comerciais complexas em nome do usuário. Seu antecessor já executa modelos de IA internos da Microsoft, bem como modelos da OpenAI fornecidos no serviço de computação em nuvem Azure da Microsoft.
A nova versão surge em meio a uma onda de chips personalizados de concorrentes de computação em nuvem e empresas de IA, como a OpenAI, com o objetivo de afrouxar o domínio da Nvidia (NVDA.O) no mercado de computação de IA.
Para construir o chip, a Microsoft adotou uma abordagem técnica diferente da Nvidia, cujos aceleradores de IA utilizam um chip de computação massivo rodeado por chips de memória de alta largura de banda.
O processador central do chip Maia 300 da Microsoft é composto por "chiplets" — geralmente chips especializados unidos — que utilizam tecnologia de 2 nanômetros da Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co (2330.TW) para funções computacionais essenciais.
Outros chiplets incluídos no projeto utilizam tecnologia de 3 nanômetros, mais barata, para funções como a transferência de dados do processador para outras partes do sistema.
Os processadores Maia 300 serão instalados em racks que contêm 96 chips e consomem cerca de 167 quilowatts de energia, em comparação com os 142 quilowatts consumidos pelos racks de servidores GB300 AI mais recentes da Nvidia, que possuem 72 unidades de processamento gráfico (GPUs).
A Microsoft afirmou que os chips Maia 300 proporcionarão cerca de 40% mais computação útil por megawatt do que os "principais sistemas baseados em GPUs", embora não tenha especificado quais sistemas foram usados para a comparação.
"Trata-se basicamente de fornecer mais inteligência para cada watt, cada dólar e cada byte de memória, otimizando todo o sistema", disse Rani Borkar, presidente de sistemas e infraestrutura de hardware do Azure na Microsoft, em entrevista à Reuters.
A Microsoft afirmou que planeja implementar "implantações de múltiplos gigawatts" do chip Maia 300 a partir do próximo ano. A Microsoft também declarou que espera investir mais de US$ 175 bilhões em despesas de capital neste ano.
(Por Stephen Nellis e Max Cherney)

items.title: Remessas globais de smartphones registram pior terceiro trimestre em 14 anos em meio à escassez de memória
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: As remessas globais de smartphones caíram 20% em relação ao ano anterior, atingindo o nível mais baixo para um terceiro trimestre desde 2012, devido ao aumento vertiginoso dos custos dos chips de memória e à escassez de suprimentos, que pressionaram os fabricantes e elevaram os preços, segundo estimativas preliminares da Counterpoint Research divulgadas nesta segunda-feira.
items.body:
As remessas globais de smartphones caíram 20% em relação ao ano anterior, atingindo o nível mais baixo para um terceiro trimestre desde 2012, devido ao aumento vertiginoso dos custos dos chips de memória e à escassez de suprimentos, que pressionaram os fabricantes e elevaram os preços, segundo estimativas preliminares da Counterpoint Research divulgadas nesta segunda-feira.
O aumento dos preços dos componentes de memória, impulsionado pela crescente demanda em projetos de infraestrutura de IA, elevou os custos de produção e levou os fabricantes a aumentarem os preços de varejo, reduzirem os embarques e priorizarem a lucratividade em detrimento do volume.
"Os consumidores estão mantendo seus dispositivos por mais tempo do que o estimado, considerando cada vez mais aparelhos recondicionados e priorizando dispositivos de maior valor", disse Shilpi Jain, analista sênior da Counterpoint.
A Samsung (005930.KS) manteve a liderança com 23% de participação de mercado, impulsionada pela demanda da linha Galaxy Z Fold8 e pelo fornecimento estável de componentes para seus dispositivos de gama média. As remessas caíram 3% em relação ao ano anterior durante o trimestre.
A participação de mercado da Apple (AAPL.O) atingiu 22%, ultrapassando os 20% pela primeira vez no terceiro trimestre, apesar da queda anual nas remessas.
A ausência de um modelo básico do iPhone 18 resultou em uma menor disponibilidade nos canais de distribuição no mês de lançamento em comparação com toda a linha do iPhone 17 um ano antes, afirmou a Counterpoint.
A OPPO e a vivo registraram quedas de mais de 20% nas remessas. A Xiaomi (1810.HK) registrou uma queda de mais de 30%, reduzindo sua participação de mercado para 10%, à medida que diminuiu sua exposição a dispositivos de menor preço e a alguns mercados estrangeiros para proteger suas margens de lucro.
(Por Harshita Mary Varghese)

items.title: Italian clubs condemn fans' violence as rivalry returns
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Milano Hockey Club and HC Bolzano Foxes have condemned a clash between their supporters after the sides met at the newly-opened Fiera Ice Arena in Milan.
items.body:
Milano Hockey Club and HC Bolzano Foxes have condemned a clash between their supporters after the sides met at the newly-opened Fiera Ice Arena in Milan.
The hockey rivalry between Milan and Bolzano, one of the biggest clubs in Italy, was renewed after a 14-year gap when [USN:L8N45Q06J TEXT:"Milano HC was formed"] following the success of the ice hockey tournaments at this year's Winter Olympics in the city.
The new arena hosted the Milan club's first home game on Friday against HC Innsbruck, and a sell-out crowd attended Sunday's match between the two Italian sides. Police intervened after an incident between supporters following the game.
A police spokesperson told Reuters that a small group of Milano HC supporters kicked out at a bus containing Bolzano fans as it departed.
Two individuals were identified by police and will receive bans from attending the arena. A 42-year-old man was reported for possession of an object which could be used as a weapon.
"Behaviour of this kind is unacceptable and does not represent the values of the sport, nor the passion and respect that distinguish the vast majority of supporters of both teams," the clubs said in a joint statement on Monday.
Milano HC took the lead three times in the game but lost 4-3 in overtime.

items.title: Musk has spent $366 million to help Republicans retain control of Congress
items.author: Dawn Kopecki
items.creator: Dawn Kopecki
items.summary: Elon Musk has spent roughly $366 million on the 2026 midterm elections so far, $276 million just since July, trying to help Republicans retain control of Congress, even as Democrats' chances of retaking the US House and Senate have improved.
items.body:
Elon Musk has spent roughly $366 million on the 2026 midterm elections so far, $276 million just since July, trying to help Republicans retain control of Congress, even as Democrats' chances of retaking the US House and Senate have improved.
Musk's largess, which was reported earlier by the New York Times, makes the world's richest person likely the single-biggest political donor in this year's races, according to campaign finance records.
There is a lot at stake for Musk with House Democrats calling for investigations into his [USN:L1N3OW1IO TEXT:"government contracts"] as CEO of aerospace company SpaceX (SPCX.O) as well as his work running the Department of Government Efficiency under President Donald Trump .
Here's a breakdown of his political spending, which was confirmed by a spokesman for his super PAC America PAC.
Musk has spent $366 million so far this election cycle, which began January 1, 2025.
Of that, Musk has donated at least $276 million to Republican groups and his own super PAC since July. Of the $276 million in third-quarter donations:
$158 million went to the Senate Leadership Fund, the super PAC set up to help elect Republicans to the Senate that is aligned with Senate Majority Leader John Thune, a Republican from South Dakota.
$20 million went to the Congressional Leadership Fund, the super PAC set up for House Republicans that is aligned with House Speaker Mike Johnson, a Louisiana Republican.
$76 million went to Musk's America PAC.
$10 million went to the Lone Star Liberty PAC, which is supporting Republican state Attorney General Ken Paxton's run for the US Senate in Texas, where recent polls have him in a dead heat against Democrat James Talarico.
$10 million went to the Republican Governors Association.
$2 million went to the Republican Attorneys General Association.

America PAC is helping Republican candidates in seven battleground states and nearly three dozen House races.
The new giving will be publicly disclosed when many super PACs are required to disclose their third-quarter spending on Thursday.
Musk has also donated more money through groups that don't disclose their donors, according to the New York Times report and confirmed by an America PAC spokesman.
Musk spent roughly $290 million during the last election cycle.

items.title: Resultados empresariales pondrán a prueba el repunte de las bolsas ante los riesgos de la IA
items.author: Rose Henderson, Winnie Hsu, Natalia Kniazhevich
items.summary: JPMorgan y Goldman Sachs abren la temporada de resultados del tercer trimestre en un mercado que exige más a las empresas, mientras la inflación, las tasas de interés y el gasto en IA ponen a prueba l ...
items.body: Bloomberg — Los sólidos resultados empresariales serán fundamentales para las esperanzas de un repunte de los mercados bursátiles mundiales a finales de año, ya que el resurgimiento de los temores sobre la inflación, la volatilidad de los bonos y el gasto en inteligencia artificial lastran la confianza de los inversores. Los principales bancos estadounidenses, entre ellos JPMorgan Chase & Co. ( JPM ) y Goldman Sachs Group Inc. ( GS ), dan el pistoletazo de salida este martes a la temporada de presentación de resultados del tercer trimestre, y las expectativas de los analistas son muy altas. Con las bolsas europeas y estadounidenses cerca de niveles récord, los inversores exigirán unos resultados sólidos, dada la confluencia de riesgos. Se estima que las empresas del S&P 500 registrarán un aumento del 25% en sus ganancias en comparación con el año anterior, según datos recopilados por Bloomberg Intelligence. Un modelo de Citigroup Inc. ( C ) prevé que, este trimestre, un mayor porcentaje de empresas estadounidenses supere las estimaciones que en el anterior, lideradas por los sectores de la tecnología, la sanidad y la minería. Ver más: El mercado alcista del S&P 500 cumple cuatro años: las 10 acciones más rentables desde 2022 “No es una cuestión de vida o muerte, pero sí es un “demuéstrenlo”, y el repunte necesita una confirmación, porque se ha elevado el listón", afirmó Violeta Todorova, analista de investigación sénior de Leverage Shares. “Normalmente, las empresas solo tienen que superar un listón más bajo. Esta vez tienen que saltar uno más alto”. El índice MSCI All-Country World se ha estancado desde que alcanzara un récord a mediados de agosto, a pesar de que los analistas siguen revisando al alza las previsiones de ganancias. Si bien esto ha situado las valoraciones bursátiles por debajo de la media, a los participantes en el mercado les preocupa que una desaceleración del gasto de los consumidores frene el crecimiento económico general. Estos son los temas clave que los inversores están siguiendo esta temporada: Los analistas prevén que las acciones estadounidenses relacionadas con la IA registren un aumento del 47% en los beneficios del tercer trimestre, superando a todos los sectores excepto al de la energía, según datos de BI. Se estima que el sector de las tecnologías de la información representará un tercio de los beneficios totales del S&P 500 este año. Ver más: Resultados de tecnológicas pondrán a prueba las estrategias de dispersión en Wall Street En Asia, se espera que las empresas taiwanesas y surcoreanas impulsen un aumento del 66% en el crecimiento regional de los beneficios, gracias a la demanda de inteligencia artificial, según datos de Bloomberg. Sin embargo, dado que el índice MSCI World Information Technology ha alcanzado máximos históricos tras una subida del 31% este año, el listón está muy alto para nuevas ganancias. “Ya no se premia simplemente por superar las previsiones y revisar al alza los objetivos, porque eso ya se da por hecho”, afirmó Dave Mazza, CEO de Roundhill Financial. “Este trimestre, el listón está en superar las previsiones, revisar al alza los objetivos, elevar las previsiones para todo el año y demostrar la solidez de los márgenes”. Los resultados de Micron Technology Inc. ( MU ) a principios de este mes recibieron una tibia acogida por parte de los inversores, a pesar de que la empresa superó las expectativas y señaló una demanda duradera relacionada con la IA. La semana pasada, las acciones de Samsung Electronics Co. cayeron un 2,4% a pesar de que su ganancia operativa trimestral se multiplicó casi por nueve. Las perspectivas para los operadores de redes eléctricas y los proveedores de infraestructuras se ven impulsadas por el gasto relacionado con los centros de datos de las grandes empresas tecnológicas, entre las que se incluyen Alphabet Inc. ( GOOGL ), Amazon.com Inc. ( AMZN ), Microsoft Corp. ( MSFT ), Meta Platforms Inc. ( META ) y Oracle Corp. ( ORCL ). Ver más: El alza de los rendimientos de los bonos podría limitar las subidas de tasas de los bancos centrales No obstante, el ritmo de captación de fondos ha inquietado a los inversores en medio del repunte de los rendimientos de los bonos. Un indicador del riesgo crediticio de SpaceX ( SPCX ) alcanzó un nuevo máximo y los bonos de la empresa se depreciaron en el mercado secundario la semana pasada. La resiliencia económica ha sido un pilar de apoyo para la renta variable. Ahora, los inversores buscan indicios de que una gama más amplia de sectores sensibles al ciclo —como el de consumo, el industrial y el bancario— estén contribuyendo al crecimiento de las ganancias. “Resultará especialmente interesante observar lo que ocurre en estos sectores no tecnológicos como indicador de la economía en general”, afirmó Emma Moriarty, gestora de carteras de CG Asset Management. “Me pregunto si se trata casi de una economía de doble vía, en la que la inteligencia artificial y los servicios asociados están obteniendo muy buenos resultados, mientras que al resto de la economía quizá le vaya menos bien”. Un análisis de Morgan Stanley ( MS ) muestra que las ganancias de la mediana de las acciones del índice Russell 3000 están en vías de aumentar un 14% en 2026, lo que indica un contexto fundamental “sólido”, según señaló el estratega Michael Wilson. Este destacó el sector industrial, donde las revisiones de ganancias siguen siendo sólidas y las valoraciones han descendido desde el verano. “Esperamos que la calidad de las ganancias, el flujo de caja libre y la amplitud de las revisiones sean los factores diferenciadores clave”, afirmó Wilson. Una cesta de Goldman Sachs compuesta por las denominadas acciones de “alta intensidad de capital” en Europa, que cuentan con activos físicos, ha superado en rendimiento a un índice de sectores de “baja intensidad de capital”, que dependen en mayor medida de activos humanos o digitales. Denominadas HALO, acrónimo de “heavy-assets low-obsolescence” (activos pesados y baja obsolescencia), estas acciones se consideran menos expuestas a la volatilidad relacionada con la inteligencia artificial y abarcan sectores como los servicios públicos y la energía. Ver más: Bonos de EE.UU. afrontan una semana clave ante el dato de inflación y las señales de la Fed “La ventaja de Europa radica en “el precio y un tipo diferente de beneficios””, señaló Alpesh Patel, socio director de RootBridge Capital. “La escasa ponderación del sector tecnológico en Europa —aproximadamente el 10% del Stoxx 600— constituye una cobertura en caso de que el gasto en inversión en IA resulte oneroso”. En Asia, los inversores también buscan garantías de que el crecimiento de las ganancias pueda extenderse más allá del sector tecnológico, que ejerce una gran influencia en la cadena de suministro de la IA. El índice MSCI Asia-Pacífico ha superado este año tanto al S&P 500 como al Stoxx 600. Los sectores orientados al consumo han sido algunos de los que más se han quedado rezagados este año, ya que el repunte de los precios de la energía se traslada a los precios de los combustibles, mientras que el aumento de los rendimientos de los bonos se traduce en tasas más altas para las hipotecas, los préstamos para la compra de automóviles y las tarjetas de crédito. Esto podría perjudicar las ganancias de los minoristas y otros sectores centrados en el mercado nacional. Los inversores esperan ahora los comentarios de las empresas sobre si la menor demanda de los consumidores o las preocupaciones por la inflación están empezando a repercutir en el crecimiento económico general. Los primeros resultados han sido mediocres. Costco Wholesale Corp. ( COST ) registró unas ganancias trimestrales mejores de lo esperado, pero ha señalado que el número de socios de pago ha aumentado menos de lo previsto. Las acciones de la cadena sueca de moda rápida Hennes & Mauritz AB cayeron después de que los analistas indicaran que los márgenes de ganancia de la empresa se redujeron significativamente, excluyendo el impacto de las devoluciones de aranceles estadounidenses. Ver más: ¿Conviene hoy una cartera con 60% de acciones y 40% de bonos? Esto dice Goldman Sachs Las empresas de consumo chinas también se enfrentan a otra temporada de resultados difícil, ya que el gasto moderado y la frágil confianza frenan la demanda ante la ausencia de un paquete de estímulo importante. La pregunta clave es cuándo comenzarán los inversores a reposicionarse de cara a una recuperación de las acciones de consumo asiáticas, señaló Josh Gilbert, analista principal para Asia-Pacífico de eToro Ltd. “Los mejores puntos de entrada suelen presentarse cuando las perspectivas aún parecen sombrías, pero dado que tanto el petróleo como las tasas de interés siguen evolucionando en la dirección equivocada, no parece que ese momento haya llegado ya”. El aumento de los rendimientos impulsó las acciones bancarias a principios de este año, ante las expectativas de mayores márgenes crediticios. Sin embargo, a medida que las tasas siguen subiendo, los inversores se muestran cada vez más preocupados por la calidad crediticia, el crecimiento de los préstamos y la actividad en los mercados de capitales. Ver más: La IA impulsa el comercio mundial de mercancías y lleva a la OMC a elevar su previsión para 2026 En Europa, las preocupaciones fiscales francesas amenazan a uno de los sectores con mejor rendimiento de la región. El sector bancario del Stoxx 600 ha caído alrededor de un 8% en las últimas dos semanas. “En el caso de los bancos, se observará si el crecimiento de los préstamos sigue siendo muy sólido. Pero en lo que respecta a la construcción de carteras, el dólar marginal seguirá destinándose, en nuestro caso, a EE.UU. o a los mercados emergentes”, declaró a Bloomberg TV Nataliia Lipikhina, directora de estrategia de renta variable para EMEA en JPMorgan Private Bank. JPMorgan adoptó una postura cautelosa respecto a las entidades crediticias del sudeste asiático la semana pasada, advirtiendo de que el aumento de los rendimientos a largo plazo podría provocar pérdidas por valoración a precios de mercado y lastrar los ingresos de los mercados de capitales. “Es probable que la sorpresa de cara al tercer trimestre de 2026 sea negativa para bastantes bancos de los que hacemos seguimiento”, escribió el analista Harsh Wardhan Modi en una nota, en la que recomendaba a los clientes que redujeran sus asignaciones. -Con la colaboración de Sagarika Jaisinghani, Matt Clinch y Michael Msika. FAST

PARIS, Oct 12 : France's LVMH on Monday reported worse-than-expected third-quarter organic sales growth as weak demand for its fashion and leather goods weighed. 
Organic sales, which strip out currency swings, rose 1 per cent year-on-year to €18.28 billion ($20.40 billion), compared with the 1.3 per cent increase expected by analysts in Visible Alpha consensus. The fashion and leather goods division, which includes flagship brands Louis Vuitton and Dior and generates nearly half of group revenue, posted a 5 per cent fall in organic sales, against an expected 1.8 per cent decline. 
The trading update from LVMH - the world's largest luxury group and the first major firm to report third-quarter results - looked likely to further unsettle investors amid fears that the $350 billion luxury sector, mired in a three-year slowdown, will struggle to regain its former momentum.
($1 = 0.8960 euros)

(reporting by Tassilo Hummel, editing by Dominique Patton )

items.title: 欧州外為市場＝ドル1年半ぶり高値圏、中東情勢と米物価指標に警戒
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ニューヨーク／ロンドン　１２日　ロイター］　 -
items.body:
［ニューヨーク／ロンドン　１２日　ロイター］　 - １２日の欧州外為市場では、ドルは１年半ぶりの高値近辺で推移した。中東紛争の激化と週内に発表される重要な米物価指標を前に、投資家が慎重姿勢を維持する中、安全資産としての需要がドルを支えた。

主要６通貨に対するドルの値動きを示すドル指数は０．１６％高の１０２．３９。先週付けた１年半ぶりの高値をわずかに下回る水準にある。

米市場規制当局の週間データによると、投資家はドルの買い持ちを積み増しており、１０月７日までの１週間では約３６０億ドルと、３週間前の８４億ドルから増加した。主にユーロが売られた。

ロンドンのＬＭＡＸグループの市場ストラテジスト、ジョエル・クルーガー氏は「市場は比較的明るいムードで週を迎えたが、その後は地政学的な不透明感の再燃と原油高がリスク選好を圧迫し、地合いが悪化した。これが新たな米ドル需要を促している」と述べた。

１４日に発表される米消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）は、今月の米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の金融政策会合を前にした最後の主要経済指標の一つで、ドルの短期的な方向を左右する重要な材料となりそうだ。

市場は追加利上げの可能性を見極めようと経済指標を注視している。ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、市場が織り込む今月の金利据え置き確率は８１％と、１カ月前の５１％から上昇した。

ユーロは０．１９％安の１．１１８０ドル。２０２７年の大統領選を前にフランスの財政健全性に対する投資家の懸念が重しとなり、先週まで５週連続で下落した。

ドル／円は１５８．５７円と小幅高。日本が祝日のため商いは薄かった。英ポンドは１．３２３ドルでほぼ横ばいだった。

ロンドンのＬＭＡＸグループの市場ストラテジスト、ジョエル・クルーガー氏は「市場は比較的明るいムードで週を迎えたが、その後は地政学的な不透明感の再燃と原油高がリスク選好を圧迫し、地合いが悪化した。これが新たな米ドル需要を促している」と述べた。

１４日に発表される米消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）は、今月の米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の金融政策会合を前にした最後の主要経済指標の一つで、ドルの短期的な方向を左右する重要な材料となりそうだ。

市場は追加利上げの可能性を見極めようと経済指標を注視している。ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、市場が織り込む今月の金利据え置き確率は８１％と、１カ月前の５１％から上昇した。

ユーロは０．１９％安の１．１１８０ドル。２０２７年の大統領選を前にフランスの財政健全性に対する投資家の懸念が重しとなり、先週まで５週連続で下落した。

ドル／円は１５８．５７円と小幅高。日本が祝日のため商いは薄かった。英ポンドは１．３２３ドルでほぼ横ばいだった。

items.title: USA Perquisition au domicile de l'élue démocrate Ilhan Omar, cible de Donald Trump
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Des agents du département de la Sécurité intérieure ont mené lundi avant l'aube une perquisition au domicile de la représentante démocrate du Minnesota Ilhan Omar, dans la région de Washington, dans le cadre d'une enquête fédérale visant l'élue d'origine somalienne, a annoncé le département de la Justice.
items.body:
Des agents du département de la Sécurité intérieure ont mené lundi avant l'aube une perquisition au domicile de la représentante démocrate du Minnesota Ilhan Omar, dans la région de Washington, dans le cadre d'une enquête fédérale visant l'élue d'origine somalienne, a annoncé le département de la Justice.
Selon une source proche du dossier, cette opération s'inscrit dans le cadre d'une enquête pénale pour fraude relative aux documents d'immigration d'Ilhan Omar, 44 ans, remplis par son défunt père alors qu'elle était enfant.
Ilhan Omar est née à Mogadiscio en 1982 et avait trouvé refuge avec sa famille au Kenya durant la guerre civile somalienne avant d'émigrer aux Etats-Unis avec les siens, dans l'Etat du Minnesota.
"Aujourd’hui, dans la région de Washington, D.C., le service des enquêtes de la Sécurité intérieure (Homeland Security Investigations) a exécuté un mandat de perquisition autorisé par la justice et délivré par le ministère de la Justice. Cette mesure coercitive s’inscrit dans le cadre d’une enquête fédérale en cours", a déclaré un porte-parole du ministère de la Justice dans un e-mail.
Le département de Sécurité intérieure fait partie de l'ICE, le service de l'immigration et des douanes des Etats-Unis, à la réputation entachée par plusieurs incidents graves depuis le début du mandat de Donald Trump.
Le porte-parole d'Ilhan Omar n’a pas répondu dans l'immédiat à une demande de commentaire.
Cette perquisition intervient un peu plus de trois semaines avant les élections de mi-mandat du 3 novembre, lors desquelles les républicains tenteront de conserver leur courte majorité au Congrès américain.
Ilhan Omar, figure de l'aile progressiste du Parti démocrate qui brigue un nouveau mandat à la Chambre des représentants, est régulièrement la cible d'insultes de la part de Donald Trump, qui présente la communauté somalienne aux Etats-Unis comme une menace pour le Minnesota.
"UNE OBSESSION INQUIÉTANTE" Ilhan Omar, qui critique ouvertement le président américain, a qualifié l’attention qu’il lui porte "d’obsession malsaine et effrayante".
La semaine dernière, Donald Trump a qualifié Abdul El-Sayed, candidat démocrate au Sénat américain pour le Michigan de confession musulmane, "d’extrémiste RADICAL" et de "sympathisant des terroristes", tout en apportant son soutien au candidat républicain, Mike Rogers.
Les défenseurs des droits civiques dénoncent la rhétorique agressive et injurieuse du président républicain à l’égard des minorités et des immigrés. Il avait notamment qualifié les Somaliens de "déchets".
En février, Donald Trump a déclaré qu’Ilhan Omar et la représentante démocrate du Michigan Rashida Tlaib, elle aussi musulmane, devraient être "internées" et renvoyées "d’où elles viennent". Les deux élues avaient critiqué le président lors de son discours sur l’état de l’Union, alors qu’il vantait la politique d’immigration intransigeante de son administration et ses mesures de répression en matière d’immigration.
Ilhan Omar a déclaré à plusieurs reprises qu’elle et sa famille avaient reçu des menaces de mort, qu’elle attribue à une "rhétorique politique haineuse".
Le mois dernier, un citoyen du Minnesota qui avait aspergé l'élue de vinaigre a été condamné à un an et deux mois de prison après avoir plaidé coupable d’agression sur un fonctionnaire. Anthony James Kazmierczak a admis avoir attaqué Ilhan Omar parce qu’il était en désaccord avec ses opinions politiques.

items.title: ＮＡＴＯ軍司令官、ロシアの攻撃に強硬対応を警告「愚かな行為」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Andrew Gray　Justyna Pawlak

[ブリュッセル／ワルシャワ １２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Andrew Gray　Justyna Pawlak

[ブリュッセル／ワルシャワ １２日 ロイター] - 北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）の欧州連合軍最高司令官、アレクサス・グリンケウィッチ米空軍大将は１２日、ロシアが「愚かにも」加盟国の領域を攻撃すれば、攻撃に関わる「あらゆるもの」を破壊すると警告した。

ワルシャワ安全保障フォーラムで演説したグリンケウィッチ氏は、敵部隊を阻止し、攻撃力をそぎ、打ち破るという３段階の対応により、いかなる攻撃も「完全に無駄に終わらせる」と言明した。

グリンケウィッチ氏はロシアを名指ししなかったが、発言の多くは明らかにロシアに向けられていた。ＮＡＴＯの２０２２年の「戦略概念」は、ロシアを同盟にとって最も重大な安全保障上の脅威と位置付けている。

同氏は「誰かが愚かにもわれわれを攻撃すれば、われわれは戦う」と述べた。「要するに、どの同盟国へのいかなる攻撃も、完全に無駄に終わるようにする」

欧州とロシアの緊張が高まる中での発言だが、欧州の同盟国の間では、トランプ米大統領がＮＡＴＯの相互防衛の約束を守るかどうかへの懸念も根強い。

トランプ氏はここ数日、ロシアによる世界市場への軽油供給を認めることで同国のプーチン大統領と合意したと発表したほか、ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領への批判を再開した。

items.title: China gloom hits LVMH, dims hopes of luxury revival
items.author: Tassilo Hummel, Alessandro Parodi
items.creator: Tassilo Hummel, Alessandro Parodi
items.summary: Luxury bellwether LVMH on Monday reported weaker-than-expected third-quarter sales as a sharp deterioration in Chinese consumer mood hit demand for its flagship brands Louis Vuitton and Dior.
items.body:
Luxury bellwether LVMH (LVMH.PA) on Monday reported weaker-than-expected third-quarter sales as a sharp deterioration in Chinese consumer mood hit demand for its flagship brands Louis Vuitton and Dior.
The trading update from the world's largest luxury group, and the first major sector player to report third-quarter results, is likely to heighten concerns that the $350 billion luxury industry, mired in a three-year slowdown, will struggle to regain momentum.
Europe's leading luxury groups have lost around €330 billion in market value since the start of the year, with LVMH alone shedding roughly 40%. LVMH's US-listed shares fell more than 3% after the trading update was published.
Organic sales, which strip out currency swings, rose 1% from a year earlier to €18.5 billion ($20.7 billion), missing analysts' expectations for growth of 1.3%, according to a Visible Alpha consensus.
The fashion and leather goods division, which generates nearly half of group revenue, posted a 5% fall in organic sales, against an expected 1.8% decline.
"We think results will likely still be a negative catalyst for the sector overall," Bank of America analysts said in a note.
RBC analyst Piral Dadhania said he expected "modest pressure" on the stocks of LVMH and its peers following the results.
Adding to investor concerns, growth in LVMH's watches and jewellery division, home to brands including Bulgari and Tiffany, slowed to 6% from 9% in the first half of the year.
The so-called "hard luxury" category, which many consumers see as offering more value than handbags and fashion, has largely withstood the broader downturn. Some analysts, however, have recently warned that resilience may be fading.
Sales in Asia, dominated by China, fell 5% from a year earlier, while sales in the US rose 5%.
"In the third quarter specifically, Asia was penalised by a sharp macro-led deterioration in Chinese consumer sentiment, with a tangible impact on discretionary expenses," Chief Financial Officer Cecile Cabanis told analysts.
China's [USN:L6N45H0G7 TEXT:"tax crackdown"] on wealthy individuals has become the latest headache for luxury brands, which are already grappling with the fallout from the Iran war and signs of slowing consumer spending in the US.
Asked about the tax crackdown on a call with analysts, Cabanis said Chinese consumers' "feel good" factor had taken a hit.
Chinese consumers account for roughly a fifth of global luxury purchases and were long the driving force behind the sector's growth. Demand has weakened sharply since the pandemic.
LVMH's fashion and leather goods division is dominated by Louis Vuitton, by far the group's largest brand. After proving more resilient than many rivals during the luxury downturn, its momentum has recently stalled.
The label has also faced a consumer backlash in China over a copyright dispute with tea chain Molly Tea, which used a logo resembling the floral motif featured on Louis Vuitton's signature monogram handbags.
Asked whether Vuitton could follow sister brand Dior in replacing its creative directors, Cabanis declined to comment but said the brand needed to step up its efforts and strike the right balance between innovation and heritage.
Cabanis said she did not believe in "drastic measures" such as price cuts to revive the brand.
Birkin bag maker Hermes and Gucci-owner Kering are due to publish third-quarter sales next week.
($1 = 0.8960 euros)

items.title: Getty Images plans bankruptcy filing, to go private
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Getty Images said on Monday it would file for bankruptcy and go private after a restructuring agreement that the visual-content provider expects to close by the end of the year.
items.body:
Getty Images (GETY.PK) said on Monday it would file for bankruptcy and go private after a restructuring agreement that the visual-content provider expects to close by the end of the year.
The company plans to begin an expedited prepackaged Chapter 11 process in the coming weeks, a major reset after the [USN:L4N4321Q8 TEXT:"collapse of its planned merger"] with rival Shutterstock (SSTK.N) amid heavy debt and growing competition from AI-generated imagery.
Once the restructuring is complete, affiliates of the Getty family and Koch Equity Development will own 100% of the company. The investors have also committed to provide up to $533 million of new equity, Getty said.
Holders of Getty's unsecured bonds agreed to retire $270 million of notes, while secured lenders agreed to reduce interest costs and extend debt maturities under the restructuring plan.
The company added that operations would continue normally and vendors would be paid in full in the ordinary course.
Getty, which competes with Reuters and the Associated Press in providing photos and videos for editorial use, said financing from Koch Equity Development of up to $143 million would support the restructuring process.
In August, Getty withdrew its financial guidance, citing an ongoing review of strategic financing alternatives and balance-sheet management initiatives, and said it had engaged Guggenheim Securities to advise on those efforts.
The visual-content provider reported total debt of about $2.1 billion as of June 30, compared with a market valuation of $20.74 million as of Friday's close.
Getty shares have lost about 99% of their value since returning to public markets in 2022 through a [USN:L4N2SV2B3 TEXT:"special purpose acquisition company"] that valued the company at about $4.8 billion, after 14 years as a private firm.
The New York Stock Exchange commenced delisting proceedings against the company at the end of September.

items.title: US DEA proposes strictest drug controls on kratom-linked products exceeding certain thresholds
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The US Drug Enforcement Administration has proposed emergency restrictions placing some products with synthetic opioid-like compounds derived from kratom under the strictest category of federal drug control, if they exceed certain concentrations.
items.body:
The US Drug Enforcement Administration has proposed emergency restrictions placing some products with synthetic opioid-like compounds derived from kratom under the strictest category of federal drug control, if they exceed certain concentrations.
The DEA issued two notices of intent on Friday, based on recommendations from the US Department of Health and Human Services, to distinguish products containing trace amounts of the substances from intentionally enhanced or concentrated formulations.
The action targets four substances linked to kratom, a plant from Southeast Asia known to produce opioid-like effects
The DEA is targeting 7-hydroxymitragynine (7-OH), found in trace amounts in kratom, and three related opioid substances derived or chemically modified from the plant: mitragynine pseudoindoxyl (MGPI), MGM-15, and MGM-16
The DEA proposed that products in which 7-OH and MGPI exceed certain concentrations, or fall below a specified mitragynine-to-7-OH/MGPI ratio, be temporarily placed in Schedule I
Schedule I of the Controlled Substances Act is reserved for drugs with a high potential for abuse and no currently accepted medical use in the United States
The DEA in August cited an immediate threat to public safety to temporarily [USN:L4N44M11L TEXT:"place"] MGPI, MGM-15 and MGM-16 under the strictest category of federal drug control
For 7-OH, the DEA said it had not yet issued a temporary scheduling order and would release a revised notice reflecting HHS's updated recommendation

items.title: England increase central contracts to record 39
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: England have expanded their number of centrally contracted players to a record 39, including 30 full contracts, the ECB said on Monday.
items.body:
England have expanded their number of centrally contracted players to a record 39, including 30 full contracts, the ECB said on Monday.
Former captain Ben Stokes and fast bowler Mark Wood retired from internationals this year, and opener Zak Crawley and left-arm seamer Luke Wood did not get renewed contracts.
Uncapped seamer Henry Crocombe was awarded a two-year deal as one of seven players added to England's full-contract list for the first time.
Jordan Cox also received a two-year deal, and Tom Banton, Sam Cook, Emilio Gay, Matthew Fisher and Dan Lawrence earned one-year contracts. Seam bowler Ollie Robinson returned to the list after holding central contracts in 2022 and 2023.
England now have 11 players on two-year contracts, with test captain Joe Root, one-day skipper Harry Brook, Jofra Archer and Jacob Bethell among nine whose deals have been extended until September 2028.
(This story has been corrected to clarify that Ben Stokes and Mark Wood retired from internationals this year, not last year, in paragraph 2.)

UK PM Burnham says Iran's IRGC likely behind RAF Fairford incident

"I can confirm our assessment that it is highly likely to have been coordinated in Iran, almost certainly directed by Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard," said UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham.

A B‑1B Lancer bomber at the RAF Fairford airbase, which hosts US Air Force personnel, in Fairford, Gloucestershire, Britain, on Sep 27, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Toby Shepheard)

LONDON: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said on Monday (Oct 12) that a suspected plot targeting the RAF Fairford air base in Britain was "highly likely" to have been coordinated in Iran, and almost certainly directed by the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps.
The RAF Fairford base in southwest England, which had been used by US bombers to carry out strikes on Iran, became the focal point for a major security response after five British men were arrested nearby in the early hours of Sep 27 on suspected terrorism and explosive offences.
US officials have told Reuters that there had been a suspected plot involving Iran to launch a drone attack, and last week US President Donald Trump said a threat linked to Iran had prompted a decision to withdraw the bombers from the base.
"I can confirm our assessment that it is highly likely to have been coordinated in Iran, almost certainly directed by Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard," Burnham told parliament.

Iran has rejected any connection with the Fairford incident.
"Tehran has had no involvement in this matter, and if the British government possesses any documents or evidence to support its claims, it should present them," said Iran's Ambassador to Britain, Seyed Ali Mousavi, according to Iran's state news agency IRNA.
FAIRFORD PLOT DETAILS SKETCHY Details around the suspected plot remain thin. The five detained men were later released without charge on police bail "under stringent conditions", and two other arrested men, including a British-Iranian national, have also been released.
Detectives have said petrol but no viable explosive had been found in vans seized along with the five men. However, both police and Burnham have pointed towards the involvement of a foreign state .
British interior minister Shabana Mahmood told parliament a known individual, whom she did not name, who was based in Iran was believed to be behind what had happened.
"We will not tolerate these threats on our soil," Burnham said. "We will crack down on Iran's use of criminal networks, using our full range of powers to target them and their funding streams, and we will bring further sanctions to restrict the capacity of Iran and the IRGC to do us harm."
Foreign ministries from almost 30 countries including the US, Canada, France and Germany issued a statement condemning "Iran’s use of violent attacks, including the acts of lethal plotting, arson, sabotage, cyber-attacks, and other hybrid activities against us and our partners".
"The UK has also concluded this event demonstrates the IRGC’s continued willingness to project hostile activity beyond its borders through covert networks and proxy actors," the statement said.
The British authorities have for a number of years accused Iran of being involved in numerous plots and attempted assassinations in Britain using criminal networks and proxies, accusations Tehran has repeatedly denied.

Related:

UK police arrest dual UK-Iranian man in Fairford air base investigation

Last year Britain said there had been 20 credible Iranian-backed threats to kill or kidnap individuals based in the UK .
In July, Britain used new powers to ban support for the IRGC and a linked group, Harakat Ashab al-Yamin al-Islamiya (HAYI), which had claimed responsibility for seven attacks earlier this year at locations linked to Jewish and Israeli communities, and Persian-language media.
British foreign minister Ed Miliband said he had summoned the Iranian ambassador while the ministry announced two Iranian nationals had been sanctioned.
The two men were Ruhollah Bazghandi, who Britain said was the IRGC's head of counterespionage operations, and Shahram Ali Reza Tamarzadeh Jakki, a facilitator for the already sanctioned Zindashti criminal network which is accused of involvement in several plots against Iranian dissidents.

Source: Reuters/rl/fs

RBI’s historic rupee defence indicates 97 per dollar is central bank’s line in the sand

Rupee surged more than 1% Monday, pulling away from the 97 level—which has emerged as a key marker for currency traders as it sits just beyond record low of 96.9650 reached in May.

Pratigya Vajpayee
,  Ruchi Bhatia
 and  Anup Roy

12 October, 2026 08:38 pm IST

Facebook

Twitter

WhatsApp

Linkedin

Indian rupee banknotes arranged for a photograph at general store in Mumbai, India, on Wednesday, July 20, 2022. Photographer: Dhiraj Singh/Bloomberg

Follow Us :

Text Size:
A-
A+

-->

India’s most aggressive currency defense in more than a decade is telling market watchers that the central bank is prepared to pull out all the stops to keep the rupee from weakening beyond 97 per dollar.

The Reserve Bank of India on Saturday announced sweeping measures to support the currency, among its toughest since the 2013 taper tantrum. The rupee surged more than 1% on Monday, pulling away from the 97 level — which has emerged as a key marker for currency traders as it sits just beyond the record low of 96.9650 reached in May.

“It is absolutely evident now that 97 per dollar is the RBI’s line in the sand for the rupee,” said Abhishek Upadhyay, an economist at ICICI Securities Primary Dealership Ltd. in Mumbai. The RBI’s message is that the rupee’s fall has been too sharp and the central bank is willing to do whatever it takes to prevent a new record low, he said.

Show Full Article

The forceful intervention follows the RBI’s first interest-rate increase in nearly four years and hawkish commentary last week, which did little to alter the currency’s course. It also shows that elevated oil prices and persistent foreign outflows from local stocks are keeping policymakers on guard against further depreciation.

The RBI wants to curb speculative bets by pushing market participants to pare positions in the forwards market and prohibit trades without real demand, according to people with knowledge of the matter, who asked not to be identified as the discussions are private.

The rupee rose to 95.5938 a dollar on Monday. It is still down about 6% this year, one of the worst performers in Asia. RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra said last week the currency was undervalued on some gauges, and that markets can be irrational in the short term.

The central bank again intervened in the onshore market on Monday to support the rupee, traders familiar with the matter said.

‘Bad Optics’
Australia & New Zealand Banking Corp., Crédit Agricole SA and Malayan Banking Bhd also view 97 as a crucial level for the rupee. The RBI did not immediately respond to an email seeking comment on the matter.

Given its proximity to the rupee’s record low, 97 has become a key level for hedging and trading decisions, said Sajal Gupta, head of forex and commodities at Nuvama Institutional desk. “I think 97-98 levels should be protected because 100 would be like bad optics.”

The RBI’s new measures include a special window to meet state-run oil companies’ dollar needs and a reserve requirement on certain foreign-exchange derivatives. Banks and other Indian foreign-exchange market participants asked the central bank to relax these and delay their implementation, according to people familiar with the developments.

Meanwhile, bonds slumped on Monday, with the benchmark 10-year yield rising to the highest level since March 2023, after the RBI also asked banks to put aside more cash as part of a reserve requirement on a daily basis, and announced an open-market sale, where it sells bonds it already owns.

“The reputational risk is not so much a weaker rupee, but the perception that investors cannot rely on efficient and predictable access to currency hedging,” said Rajeev De Mello, global macro portfolio manager at Gama Asset Management SA. “Over the medium term, that could prove more damaging to foreign investors’ appetite for Indian bonds than allowing the rupee to adjust to the global energy shock.”

The measures introduced are the latest attempt by RBI to support the rupee. Earlier this year, it limited daily net open positions for banks at $100 million and barred lenders from offering clients non-deliverable rupee contracts, a restriction it later rolled back. It also removed taxes on bond investments by global funds later.

Then, in June, the RBI sought to bring in capital flows through a diaspora deposit program. That raised a record $133 billion, swelling its foreign exchange reserves to nearly $800 billion in early September. Since then, the stockpile has fallen $51 billion, partly due to its efforts to support the rupee.

While the oil window will remove some dollar demand from companies in the market, it will further drain the RBI’s reserves, said Dhiraj Nim, FX strategist at ANZ in Mumbai.

What Bloomberg Strategists say:

“The Indian rupee needs more than a series of stop-gap measures to fundamentally put it on a more resilient trajectory. The more-than-40% surge in Brent crude since the start of the Iran war and a 5% loss in the value of the rupee since then have raised India’s import bill. So, unless the country can address the trade deficit, the rupee will continue to stay under pressure beyond today’s gains.”

— Ven Ram, cross-asset strategist.

The latest steps target demand in the foreign-exchange derivatives market. For the first time, the RBI introduced a FX risk reserve, requiring lenders to hold with the central bank the rupee equivalent of 20% of the notional value of each derivative transaction above $2 million. The People’s Bank of China has a similar tool to manage pressures on the yuan by varying the reserve requirement on forward contracts.

“The RBI still has a lot of policy measures it can introduce to prevent the rupee from falling past 97,” said Eugenia Victorino, head of Asia strategy at Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken in Singapore. “It is likely hoping that these measures buy them time until oil prices pull back yet again.”

–With assistance from Bhaskar Dutta.

Authors: Pratigya Vajpayee, Ruchi Bhatia and Anup Roy
